introduction_markdown: This paper is arranged in two sections, A and B. Answer ALL questions in Sections A and B. Section A: Answer ALL the questions in the spaces provided (10 questions); the mark allocation for each question is indicated. Section B: Answer ALL FOUR questions; all questions in Section B carry equal marks (15 marks each). You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators are allowed. Duration: two and a half hours.
enonce_intro_markdown:
A man and his wife with two of their children went for a 5-day pleasure trip. They hired a car to use for the trip. The daily rental price for the car was 18,000 FCFA. The car consumed fuel at the rate of 12,500 FCFA per day.

Calculate:
incertitudes: Q B1 : le sujet n'imprime que le total (15 marks), pas de bareme par sous-question. Lecture : « the cost of running the car for 1 day » = location + carburant = 18 000 + 12 500 = 30 500 FCFA ; « daily feeding for the family » = 15 000 FCFA par jour pour toute la famille (4 personnes) ; 2 chambres a 15 000 FCFA chacune et par jour.

questions.enonce_markdown: a) the cost of running the car for 1 day.
questions.corrige_markdown:
The daily cost is the rental price plus the fuel: $18\,000+12\,500=30\,500$ FCFA.

**Answer: $30\,500$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: b) the total cost of running the car for 5 days.
c) They lodged in two rooms in a hotel where each room cost 15,000 FCFA per day. Calculate their total cost of lodging for the 5 days.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Cost of the two rooms for one day: $2\times15\,000=30\,000$ FCFA.

For $5$ days: $5\times30\,000=150\,000$ FCFA.

**Answer: $150\,000$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: d) The daily feeding for the family was 15,000 FCFA. Calculate the total cost of feeding for the whole family during the 5 days.
questions.corrige_markdown:
The feeding for the whole family costs $15\,000$ FCFA each day, so for $5$ days: $5\times15\,000=75\,000$ FCFA.

**Answer: $75\,000$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: e) the total amount spent by the family for the 5 days.
questions.corrige_markdown:
Add the car, the lodging and the feeding:

$152\,500+150\,000+75\,000=377\,500$ FCFA.

**Answer: $377\,500$ FCFA.**

questions.enonce_markdown: f) The man and wife decided to pay the bills for the trip in the ratio 3:2 respectively. Find the amount that the man paid. *[15 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The ratio $3:2$ has $3+2=5$ parts. The man pays $3$ parts out of $5$:

$\dfrac35\times377\,500=3\times75\,500=226\,500$ FCFA.

Check: the wife pays $\dfrac25\times377\,500=151\,000$ FCFA and $226\,500+151\,000=377\,500$.

**Answer: the man paid $226\,500$ FCFA.**
